flags.summary: The party has met Rahadin, the chamberlain (court_rahadin:start, chamber or intercept).
The party beat Rahadin in a fight (court_rahadin_fight or court_rahadin_chamber_fight). Endings and epilogues may read it.
Rahadin let the party take Gertruda down the grand stairs (court_rahadin:stand_aside).
The party knows the vault is behind the lady's portrait in the King's Hall (Lief, his ledger, or Ludmilla). Opens the portrait with no roll.
The portrait in the King's Hall alcove has been swung aside (court_halls:open): the secret stair to the treasury is open.
The party read the count's ledger, or Lief told them: the vault is behind the lady, and Gertruda's gowns are an open account. Convinces Gertruda.
The rug of smothering in Lief's office is destroyed (court_accountant_rug); Lief can leave.
The party has spoken with Lief Lipsiege.
Lief Lipsiege left the castle, free (court_lief:go_vallaki or go_free). Endings and epilogues may read it.
The animated armour in the guardroom was beaten (court_post_watch).
The count's portrait and the gallery armour were destroyed (court_portrait_watch).
The party has met the three brides in the lounge (court_brides:first).
The party fought the brides in the lounge (court_brides_fight). Endings and epilogues may read it.
Anastrasya told the party she was once the girl in the yellow guest room. Convinces Gertruda; Anastrasya stays out of a fight.
At her own asking, the party laid Anastrasya Karelova to rest (court_brides:rest). Endings and epilogues may read it.
The party found the silver dragon Argynvost's skull mounted in the castle's trophy room (Argynvostholt's quest the_dark_beacon wants it home).
The party lifted Argynvost's skull down from the castle's trophy wall to take it home to Argynvostholt.
The party has met Gertruda in the yellow guest room.
Insight saw that Gertruda is frightened under the chatter; the party can tell her so.
A failed Persuasion made Gertruda ring for Strahd: Rahadin will not be talked aside at the stairs.
Gertruda agreed to go home and joined the party as a guest (court_gertruda:join).
The party gave Gertruda back to Rahadin at the stairs; she stays in the castle (find_gertruda lost). Endings and epilogues may read it.
Gertruda is home with Mad Mary in the village of Barovia (court_gertruda:homecoming; find_gertruda home). Endings and epilogues may read it.
A torch was set back in the false treasury's empty sconce (court_way:sconce): the panel to the hall of webs opens.
The party found the vent and bellows under the false treasury's trapped chest (court_way:gas_chest): opening it is easier.
The false treasury's trapped chest has gone off or been opened safely (court_way:gas_chest). If the whole party fell asleep they woke in the guest room four hours later.
The party took the money from the false treasury's trapped chest.
The belfry's rope was pulled (court_way:rope): the bell tolled and the giant spiders came.
The giant spiders the belfry's bell called were destroyed (court_way_spiders).
The rats packed into the shapes of guards in the west wing's alcoves are destroyed (court_vermin), and the steel door to the count's dining hall stands unguarded.
Strahd's armour on the parapets is broken (court_parapet_watch).
Someone pocketed the porcelain groom from the floor of the count's dining hall. The next time the party walks in, the wedding cake has burst open and the window is broken outward.
The harp in the count's dining hall was played well enough, or the dead blessed over it, and the first Pidlwick's ghost came to talk.
The party has seen the Hall of Heroes' statues by lightning.
How many questions the statues in the Hall of Heroes have answered (seven in all; the third and the seventh are false).
Someone touched the dancing dress from the coffin-shaped wardrobe in the servants' upper rooms, and it dropped, empty.
The ladder behind the mirror in the servants' upper rooms, down into the high tower's stair, is found (both its ends open).
The Hall of Heroes' statues have answered question 1.
The Hall of Heroes' statues have answered question 2.
The Hall of Heroes' statues have answered question 3.
The Hall of Heroes' statues have answered question 4.
The Hall of Heroes' statues have answered question 5.
The Hall of Heroes' statues have answered question 6.
The Hall of Heroes' statues have answered question 7.
